notes: «بدمشق» is a place phrase, not part of the name; «الكاتب» and «المعروف بابن ...» are kept as the names stand
«فلما رجع ... أتته قريش» has قريش as the subject of the event, not a link
the Prophet's saying is reported by Jabir; the Prophet is not a link
the archive's flag that the report relies on the previous report is not borne out: the text carries its own full chain
